column2: Make it harder: hold a weight plate in front of your chest.
Superman on the floor: lie on your front, lift arms and legs slightly.
Sit down, back and bum firmly against the backrest.
Place your feet hip-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and bend your knees towards your chest under control.
Go as deep as you can while your bum stays on the seat.
Push back through your whole foot; don't fully lock your knees at the top.
Breathe in as you bend, breathe out as you push.
